Evidence: ecological empathy, biodiversity awareness, shared outdoor spaces
#Nature #Science 🌐

Ecologists and zoologists are urging a cultural shift to stop viewing insects as mere pests, highlighting their role in pollination and pest control.

Recognizing insects as partners reduces the reliance on harmful insecticides that damage native species.
